status: Concept proposals; not implemented or approved production assets.

confirmed.gameplay: Pre-battle skill ordering and trigger conditions, automatic combat

unconfirmed: One active hero and four skill slots are scope suggestions only
Relationship to existing Godot-RogueIdle project is unconfirmed

variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished landscape 16:9 in-game art-direction mockup for an ORIGINAL Godot 2D side-view single-player tactical auto-battler for Steam, feasible for one solo developer with AI. This is a fictional proposed game, not a screenshot of an existing game. Show an actual readable playable interface, not a poster, not a collage, no desktop device frame. Same layout for comparison: thin top resource/navigation strip; upper 55% is a horizontally staged side-view battle preview, one small hero facing three distinct enemies across a clear horizontal ground plane; lower 40% is a substantial pre-battle skill sequencing workbench. Exactly FOUR large ordered skill tiles across the bottom with visible 01, 02, 03, 04 badges, distinct action icons, simple arrows between them and a clearly separate condition socket under each. Conditions are optional gating checks, NOT spaghetti flowcharts. The first slot is selected, and a modest pale projected path in battlefield previews its target. Show enemy intent icon above each enemy and clean health bars. Clear visual hierarchy, generous padding, highly legible Chinese UI, restrained text, high quality real game UI with style-specific shapes. Text ONLY short labels: top left "战前编排", top right "第 03 战"; bottom heading "技能顺序"; four skill names "斩击", "护盾", "治疗", "重击"; beneath them respective condition chips "总是", "敌人蓄力", "生命 < 40%", "能量 ≥ 3"; lower right button "开始战斗". Small icons and small numeric health values allowed. No company logo, no game title, no watermark. Heroes and creatures have simple strong silhouettes and separable animation-friendly parts; environment is only three reusable parallax layers. Avoid dense character rendering, tiny illegible paragraphs, premium mobile currency shops, isometric perspective and photorealistic 3D.
Art direction A: eerie yet charming PAPER THEATRE / woodcut folktale. Flat cut-paper silhouettes with imperfect ink edges, subtle ivory paper grain, minimal angular hand-carved hatching, crisp printed shapes. Palette warm parchment ivory, charcoal black, muted vermilion, dusty slate; vermilion reserved for danger and one hero scarf. The hero is a small cloaked wandering knight with a simple sword and lantern silhouette. Enemies: a round spiny shadow, an antler-masked sentinel, a tall hollow scarecrow; avoid gore. Side-view ruined orchard and crooked shrine outlined against a huge pale moon. Background deliberately pale to make black figures readable. UI looks like beautifully designed letterpress paper slips with ink borders, worn red wax-like condition seals. Restrained, sophisticated, unmistakable indie aesthetic; quiet haunting mood, no clutter. Main visual effort in silhouettes and typography, not animation complexity.

Art direction B: ARCANE MACHINE / vintage instrument schematic. Stylish 2D flat illustrated sprites, sharp geometric mechanical silhouettes, large clean color fields, selective engraved strokes; NOT a realistic metal 3D render. Midnight petrol and deep navy background, warm amber signal lights, bone typography, muted oxidized brass outlines. Hero is a compact clockwork knight with round torso and one glowing furnace eye, enemies are a floating lens drone, a beetle automaton and a tall bell guardian. Side-on abandoned observatory factory with broad arch shapes and constellation wiring. UI resembles an elegant operator's control desk: four removable skill cartridges in numbered sockets, luminous amber conditional tabs and a single clear bus line. Make rule programming physically understandable through sockets and lamps, not complex circuitry. Very clear comfortable text contrast and quiet background. Sparse amber sparks, understated industrial occult atmosphere. Distinctive graphic engineering illustration aesthetic suitable for reusable segmented sprites.

Art direction C: BRIGHT BOTANICAL RISOGRAPH STORYBOOK. Highly stylized flat two-dimensional hand-cut shapes, bold rounded ink outline, slightly offset risograph print texture, warm cream background with moss green, terracotta orange, small cornflower blue accents. Cozy but tactical, curious fairy-tale world, premium illustrated indie PC game. Hero is a tiny seed knight with leaf cloak and acorn helmet; enemies a grumpy red mushroom creature, a thorn hedgehog and a taller vine beetle. Full side-view woodland hollow with simplified giant leaves and layered botanical shapes, bright negative space around the fighters. The four skill cards are neatly printed field-journal specimens with small colored tabs; condition chips look like labeled botanical tags, extremely tidy alignment. Charming expressive silhouettes without excessive character details, avoid childish mobile-game gloss. Clear large typography, no watercolor blur. Warm approachable visual identity with restrained texture and animation-friendly cutout characters.

design_notes: Show why a condition triggered or failed during combat
Separate simulation events from animation and UI
Prototype ordering, condition checks, automatic combat and retry before expanding content
Concept backgrounds should be simplified into reusable layers; icons and character parts need separate production assets
